A higher rate on a small base is fewer people than a lower rate on a large one.
Youth (15–24): 47.2% in 2025, from annual counts. DoS publishes age 24+ only (18.0% in Q2 2026).
Source: DoS PxWeb counts EMPALL1/EMPALL (2025 annual, Jordanians 15+); participation from DoS Q2 2026 release. Shares rounded to whole people per 100.
